name: tabularium
description: Venue-qualified credit-event releases rebuilt from preserved source records.

interface.shortDescription: Venue-qualified credit-event releases rebuilt from preserved source records.
interface.longDescription: Tabularium turns preserved Aave v4, Euler v1, and Euler v2 records into deterministic, venue-qualified credit events without discarding the native source or mapping provenance. It also rebuilds one non-canonical Compound v3 Phase 0 execution witness from a verified Alexandria release. Offline verification reconstructs the expected bytes instead of trusting row claims. The canonical Compound Phase 1 adapter and Ethereum USDC interval specimen have not shipped.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $tabularium to build or verify a source-bound Aave v4, Euler v1 or Euler V2 credit-event release, or rebuild a Compound v3 Phase 0 witness offline.
